jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer, Data Warehouse (TPL)
jobs.description: About Us Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified – giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies. In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition. Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship . About the Role   As Principal Data Engineer, you will own the intraday and end-of-day data serving layer between the CTRM platform and its downstream consumers. You will shape the architecture, standards and engineering practices that enable teams across the business to access trusted, timely and well-defined data. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with the opportunity to influence how the business builds and uses its data platform.   This will be a full-time role, based in our London office, owning the following  responsibilities :   Own the intraday and EOD data serving layer between the CTRM platform and its consumers, including Market Risk, Credit Risk, Treas

jobs.description: About There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, ML & Experimentation (f/m/d)
jobs.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually. Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second , we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time. Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake , providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange. Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training , NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference . We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem. The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day , 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines , and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second . jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA) . Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds; Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten; Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model ; Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse; Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL ; Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum ; Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren; Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Pré : 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen € 4.00

jobs.title: Production & ESG Data Engineer
jobs.description: Are you passionate about data, technology and sustainability? ONE-Dyas is looking for a Production & ESG Data Engineer to ensure the accurate collection, administration and reporting of production, hydrocarbon and ESG data. You will turn complex data into reliable insights that support operational and business decisions. What will you do? · Maintain and improve databases containing validated production and ESG data. · Collect and integrate data from production sources and operated and non-operated assets. · Prepare clear monthly, quarterly and annual reports and visualizations. · Support Production, Engineering, HSE and ESG teams with data supporting operational and business decisions. · Explore opportunities for automation, machine learning and AI to improve collection, administration and reporting. · A bachelor’s level in Engineering, Accounting, Computer Science, Environmental Sciences or a related field. · Experience in data engineering or ESG reporting, preferably within the energy or oil & gas industry. · Knowledge of database management, data visualization and data governance. · Preferably experience with Python, SQL or similar tools. · Strong communication and problem-solving skills. · A proactive, independent and team-oriented approach with an interest in sustainability. Meet ONE-Dyas ONE-Dyas B.V. is the largest privately owned exploration and production company in the Netherlands. As entrepreneurs in Dutch offshore gas and oil, the company aims to make a significant contribution to the energy transition, working at the forefront of sustainability and technological innovation. Extracting gas and oil close to home contributes to the national economy, security of supply, and climate goals by employing local services, products, and know-how, reducing the reliance on imported fuels, cutting emissions, and complying to the highest environmental standards in the industry.
